scraped.title: Hellenic Statistical Authority
scraped.subtitle: Provision of Expertise to the Hellenic Statistical Authority in selected Statistical Domains, including Public Finance Statistics
scraped.description: Financed by the European Union and commissioned by Eurostat, this project supports the Hellenic Statistical Authority (ELSTAT) in improving its institutional environment, enhancing its capacity to produce high-quality statistical data, and ensuring compliance with EU…
body: Financed by the European Union and commissioned by Eurostat, this project supports the Hellenic Statistical Authority (ELSTAT) in improving its institutional environment, enhancing its capacity to produce high-quality statistical data, and ensuring compliance with EU standards. The project aligns with the Joint Official Statistics Greece Action Plan (JOSGAP), with a particular focus on strengthening national accounts and government finance statistics.

ICON is providing project management assistance and expert consultancy to facilitate ELSTAT’s development. The key output is the formulation of a coherent work program, translating ELSTAT’s priorities into expert missions and actionable terms of reference while ensuring full alignment with JOSGAP objectives. Regular reporting and follow-up ensure Eurostat is informed of progress and any challenges encountered. ICON is responsible for:
Supporting ELSTAT in implementing a structured work program for statistical development.
Managing and coordinating consultancy missions across various statistical domains.
Providing technical expertise to improve national accounts and public finance statistics, ensuring alignment with EU regulations.
Selecting experienced experts in close cooperation with ELSTAT and Eurostat.
